new_events.summary: Reporting describes explosion on Omani Didamar Island; Iranian actor claim of strike and rationale are not independently verified. Omani official reportedly confirmed explosion, not full attribution or BDA.

geospatial.source_location_description: Didamar Island, Oman; exact impact site unresolved

existing_event_updates.summary: Saudi-led coalition reported interception of Houthi missiles directed toward Riyadh and southern Saudi Arabia and drone in eastern Saudi Arabia. Houthi spokesperson claimed strikes on airport and Abqaiq facility; independent impacts unverified.

geospatial.source_location_description: Riyadh, southern and eastern Saudi Arabia; interception/impact coordinates not sourced

existing_event_updates.summary: Reuters reviewed evidence of tanker fires and continuing shipping attacks; specific vessels and incident coordinates require separate vessel-by-vessel verification.

geospatial.source_location_description: Strait of Hormuz and surrounding waterways, vessel-specific positions unresolved

claims_and_corrections.claim: Houthi spokesperson claimed attacks against King Khalid International Airport and Abqaiq oil facility; reported interception does not confirm impact.
Iranian security official Mohsen Rezaei said there were currently no Tehran-Washington negotiations; distinguish this statement from earlier Qatar-mediated contacts.

economic_energy_updates.summary: Reuters reported November 10 Brent settlement $91.49/bbl and WTI $86.04/bbl, two-month lows; market prices do not establish conflict normalization.

Orlen announced termination of one QatarEnergy long-term LNG contract after delivery force majeure; contract covers approximately one million metric tons per year, with 60-day effective period. Second contract continues.

S&P Global Energy vessel tracking cited by Reuters: 31 laden LNG tankers exited Hormuz in October (23 Ras Laffan, 8 Das Island), up from 23 September; historical monthly comparison not evidence of unrestricted transit.
